visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a metallic industrial oven, a whole roasted duck with glossy reddish-brown skin hangs from a hook against a stainless steel background. The lighting is bright and warm, reflecting off the oily surface of the bird. (2) A person wearing black latex gloves uses a large metal cleaver to chop through the roasted duck on a thick circular wooden chopping block; juicy meat is revealed as the blade strikes. (3) A male chef in a black polo shirt and a backwards black baseball cap stands in a kitchen area, gesturing with his hands while speaking to the camera; stainless steel equipment and wooden slat walls are visible behind him. (4) Multiple roasted ducks hang in a row inside a large cylindrical roasting drum, their skins shimmering under the overhead kitchen lights. (5) A close-up shows the cleaver slicing through a slab of crispy roasted pork belly (Siu Yuk) on the wooden block, with the crackling skin visibly textured and golden-brown. (6) Various plated meals are shown on a white table, featuring white rice topped with roasted duck, char siu, and green vegetables like bok choy and sprouts; the camera zooms in on the glistening meat. (7) A close-up of a spoon lifting a portion of steamed egg custard topped with a black truffle paste, showing a smooth yellow texture. (8) The camera pans across a plate of 'Hua Pi' roasted pork, showing uniform slices with distinct layers of fat and crispy skin, topped with green scallion oil. (9) A close-up of a small plastic container filled with golden needle mushrooms in a red spicy sauce. (10) The camera shows a bowl of clear soup containing a piece of pork bone, a slice of ginger, and a shiitake mushroom. (11) The interior of the restaurant is shown, featuring white tables, light wood chairs, and walls decorated with vintage-style Hong Kong neon and wooden signs. (12) An exterior shot shows the restaurant storefront with a large banner displaying the name 'SING-YUN BBQ' and a picture of roasted duck.
